root_cause: The transactions are experiencing interchange downgrades and excess fees due to a misconfigured Merchant Category Code (MCC) on the payment gateway.
diagnosis: The merchant's gateway is misconfigured with an incorrect MCC instead of the registered B2B wholesale code 5045, resulting in systemic fee overcharges across 13 transactions. Note that this analysis relies on an illustrative modeled benchmark.
action_rationale: Updating the gateway configuration to the correct registered MCC 5045 will align processing rates with contracted B2B wholesale pricing and stop ongoing fee leaks.
